notes: A (GOT): 160 distressed units transcribed from the DEQ list dated 2/16/2026 (designations as of 2/4/2026); 64 counties have at least one. Unit names are as printed (no 'Town of' prefix in source). Five units are listed by DEQ in more than one county (Grifton, Kenly, Mount Olive, Sharpsburg, Whitakers) and are counted in EACH listed county, so per-county counts sum to 166, not 160. The Sept 2025 SWIA staff report said 151 units 'with active systems' were distressed; the Feb 2026 list has 160 rows; the difference was not reconciled. B (PARTIAL): DEQ Division of Water Infrastructure awards approved by SWIA at four meetings (Jul 2025, Dec 2025, Feb 2026, Jul 2026), 308 rows, amounts exactly as listed ('Total Loans & Grants Awarded' - includes loans, not only grants). NOT included: the April 2026 SWIA round (~$215M Helene), Golden LEAF, and NC Commerce Rural Infrastructure Authority grants - not retrieved. No per-county dollar totals are given because sources do not publish them; do not sum multi_county rows (each carries the full award in every listed county). 2 awards listed as 'Multiple' counties are in unassigned_awards. County is as printed in the source even where it looks wrong: Feb 2026 lists Greenevers under Columbus (the town is in Duplin) and Jul 2026 lists Washington Park under Washington (the town is in Beaufort) - verify before display. C (NOT GOT): no published county-level septic/sewer-coverage table was found in the time available; septic_share_pct is null for all 100 counties. D (NOT GOT for 2025-2026): no current DEQ moratorium/SOC list was found; sewer_moratoria is an empty array for every county and means 'no data', not 'no moratorium'. The only list found is from July 2022 and is known stale (e.g. Kinnakeet Shores moratorium rescinded Nov 2023); it is kept separately in sewer_moratoria_2022_historical for reference only. DEQ's 2026 80/90-percent flow report exists (https://www.deq.nc.gov/2026-8090-percent-report-moratorium-list-npdes-permits/download) but is a flow table without moratorium flags and was not parsed. Method: all tables were read from DEQ PDFs through a web-fetch text extraction (no direct download possible), then parsed by script; the distressed list was extracted twice with matching results, award tables once - spot-check before publishing.
